scope: first complete high-salience homepage section immediately after Pokémon TCG Live
method: screenshot-first -> section boundary -> settled render -> visible DOM -> computed style -> loaded assets

selectedSection.reason: It is the first complete, self-contained, full-width promotional section after .tcgl-callout. The following Pokémon Championship Series begins only after this article ends and is out of scope.

claims.fact: The section starts at the hard lower seam of .tcgl-callout and ends before the Pokémon Championship Series grid. It is one ARTICLE.tcg-pocket, full-bleed at both measured viewports.

At 1440px the section is a two-column horizontal composition: a 720px pale-blue branded image field on the left and an opaque black 720px copy field on the right. The product/logo composite is the primary left visual; the right reading order is title, paragraph, centered CTA.

At 390px the horizontal split becomes a vertical stack. The asset field comes first (334.23px high), followed by a full-width opaque black copy panel (408.79px high). The primary asset scales to 370x226.44 with 10px side insets; the background switches to the mobile-specific header_bg-small.jpg.

visibleDomState.state: English en-us settled render; asset column then copy column

claims.fact: The English source copy is exactly one H2 and one paragraph. Desktop H2 is 40/44 Kanit italic 700; mobile H2 is 28/30.8 and wraps to two lines. Body remains 18/28.8 PT Sans and is centered.

The only CTA is Play Now. It is a white rectangular button with black italic text and arrow; hover changes text and arrow to gold while the white .button__bg remains white. The observed href is https://tcgpocket.pokemon.com/en-us.

The visible campaign composition uses one independent transparent product/logo raster over one responsive background. Desktop loads background.jpg; mobile loads header_bg-small.jpg. No flattened screenshot is required.

The rendered page exposed offscreen start states (image opacity 0/translateY -214.199px; title/body opacity 0/translateX right) and a later settled state (opacity 1, transform 0). In this browser run the viewport controller did not yield a reliable visible intermediate frame before settling, so exact duration, easing and stagger are not frozen and must not be invented.

visibleDomState.state: observed hidden endpoint and settled endpoint; no reliable intermediate frame

warnings: Chrome briefly auto-translated one discarded mobile run; the canonical mobile screenshot and copy measurements were re-captured from the English en-us DOM.
A small red Chinese browser-extension overlay is visible at the top-left of the mobile screenshot. It is browser chrome/injection, not source-page evidence, and must not be reproduced.
Exact motion duration/easing/stagger remain unresolved because no reliable intermediate rendered frame was captured.
